name: bu-koala
role: THE LOCKED REFERENCE — the recurring character every ai-video shot drives from
rule: NEVER generate this character from text twice. Every still that needs him is gen_image.py --ref character.png; every clip is image-to-video from a frame that already contains him. Re-deriving him from the prompt is a bug.
source_asset: photos/cute-kuala.jpg (user-created original — the design is the user's, locked with their approval)
approved: Option A chosen by user 2026-08-23 — JPG locked AS-IS, zero regeneration

voice.register: motherese — warm, slightly slowed, rising gentle intonation; see research/hebrew-kids/07-hebrew-language-kids.md
voice.notes: kokoro excluded (no Hebrew). ElevenLabs only eleven_multilingual_v3 --lang he if a richer take is ever needed. Word-exact timings come free from edge-tts.

catchphrase.design_rules: research/hebrew-kids/08-character-concepts-v2.md §9 — 4 syllables + payoff, trochaic, ends on open vowel, singable, repeatable x3 per short

design.species: a cute yellow koala-like creature (user's original design)
design.body: plush-toy chubby rounded body, soft matte warm yellow fur, cream belly patch, stubby mitten paws, short legs
design.head: oversized round head (~1/3 to 1/2 of total height), huge low-set dark glossy eyes, tiny nose, gentle open-mouth smile, chubby cheeks
design.identity_marker: the big fluffy round EARS with cream inner fluff — his silhouette signature, must appear in every shot (the way blue-man's mustard scarf does)
design.retired: the teal mood-glow antenna from concept v1/v2 — dropped; the ears already carry the silhouette identity

palette.body_yellow: warm saturated yellow (sample from locked character.jpg)

design.proportions: baby-schema — oversized head, large low-set eyes, chubby cheeks, mitten paws, stubby limbs

generation.method: Option A: user's own art copied verbatim. No gen_image call was ever made for the reference itself.
generation.note: Every FUTURE still still derives via --ref character.jpg. This file is the single source of truth.

shot_workflow: 1. start frame: gen_image.py --ref ai-shorts/bu-koala/character.jpg --prompt '<this exact yellow koala creature with his fluffy round ears, in SCENE...>' -> media/projects/bu-koala-<ep>/shots/NN-slug.png
2. clip: image-to-video from that start frame (gen_clip.py / bakeoff_clip.py) — state derived cost BEFORE spending
3. loop shots: end-frame input = same frame as start (frame 0 == last frame is a constraint we hand the model, not luck)
4. per-episode media lives in media/projects/bu-koala-<ep>/, referenced as staticFile('projects/bu-koala-<ep>/x')

script_rules.language_harness: research/hebrew-kids/07-hebrew-language-kids.md — motherese register, 3-6 word sentences, greeting 'שלום ילדים וילדות', מה זה? prompts, 2.5s engineered pauses, expand/recast correctly, warm resolve
script_rules.format: hook <2s, repetition >=3x, call-and-response with pauses, one idea resolved warmly, seamless loop, NO CTA outro (kids mode)
script_rules.captions: RTL via remotion/src/lib/shorts.tsx rtl prop + stripNikkud(); nikkud ON for kids (brand.md exception), lineHeight ~1.5, Heebo/Rubik from media/library/fonts
script_rules.motion_override: kids mode permits gentle bouncy/cartoon squash-and-stretch that default brand.md bans — declared per-project, not silently
